add.name: bpjs_round_mode

source.provision: contoh.json konvensi butir 8 dan langkah premi
source.quote: Ekspresi memakai notasi Python: // adalah pembagian bulat ke bawah; 'x * 225 // 10000' berarti 2,25% x x dibulatkan ke bawah.

add.label: rounding of BPJS premiums as computed by the worked examples (upah * 24 // 10000)

note: Aligns the 2026 baseline with the convention of every contoh.json: TER x bruto rounded down (konvensi butir 2) and BPJS premiums computed with floor division (langkah, e.g. 'u * 24 // 10000'). Premiums are billed amounts in the cases, so the second parameter only matters where a Delta recomputes premiums (U15). Applied before every change Delta; not part of any change.
